integrity: The proof is symbolic and classifies all dominating and total dominating subsets by residue-fiber support. Exhaustive checks on abstract residue models and on Z/4Z, Z/8Z, and Z/9Z are included as corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The formulas are proved for finite commutative local rings, not arbitrary finite commutative rings.
The domination polynomial determines the unit graph within the local class, not the ring isomorphism type.
title: Domination polynomials of finite local unit graphs determine the residue-fiber geometry
